meta.name: growth-loops
meta.description: Identify growth loops (flywheels) for sustainable traction. Evaluates 5 loop types: Viral, Usage, Collaboration, User-Generated, and Referral. Use when designing growth mechanisms, building product-led traction, or understanding how growth loops work.

copy.tagline: 识别并设计可持续的增长飞轮
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计产品增长机制或理解增长循环如何运作
copy.tagline_en: Identify and design sustainable growth loops
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing growth mechanisms or understanding how growth loops work

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你的产品，评估五种增长循环（病毒、使用、协作、用户生成、推荐），并给出排名、实施计划和关键指标。
howto.when: 当你描述一个产品，并询问如何实现可持续增长、减少付费获客依赖，或设计增长机制时触发。

say.text: 分析我的笔记应用，推荐最适合的增长循环。
say.note: Claude 会评估五种循环并给出排名和计划。

say.text: 我的协作工具如何设计推荐循环？
say.note: Claude 会提供推荐循环的具体机制和指标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your product, evaluates five growth loop types (Viral, Usage, Collaboration, User-Generated, Referral), and provides a ranked recommendation, implementation plan, and key metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a product and ask about sustainable growth, reducing paid acquisition, or designing growth mechanisms.

say_en.text: Analyze my note-taking app and recommend the best growth loop.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate all five loops and give a ranked plan.

say_en.text: How can my collaboration tool design a referral loop?
say_en.note: Claude will provide referral loop mechanics and metrics.
